name: figurelabs
description: Create and edit scientific figures in FigureLabs with an editable project open beside the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Create scientific figures in an editable FigureLabs project.
interface.longDescription: Create or edit scientific figures and view results in the opened project page. For requested chat images or failed browser delivery, try image preview, then a supported local-file fallback. Add checks only for requested exports, formal use or specific problems.
defaultPrompt: Connect to FigureLabs in a dedicated task, open an empty illustration project in the built-in browser, and introduce it.
